title: cleanup-unused-feature-flags-in-serving-runtime
creator: Maya Thompson
description: Cleanup and remove legacy feature flags in the serving runtime related to experimental batching and KV-cache heuristics. Goal: reduce configuration surface, remove dead code paths, and simplify rollout logic. Steps: audit flags across repos, add deprecation notices to console and docs, implement removal patches behind feature branches, run microbenchmarks and end-to-end smoke tests, coordinate canary rollout with eng-sre and QA. Expected risk: low but requires careful canarying in dedicated pools and rollback hooks. Refer to linked PRs and runbooks for testing and deployment notes.
